en: Changed the question that turns on the mods Claude writes in a session to plain text with no link or session id; it stays up when a new turn starts, and Claude tells you what loaded when you turn them on
zh: 变更开启 Claude 在 session 中编写的 mod 的提问，改为纯文本，不含链接或 session id；新回合开始时仍会显示，开启后 Claude 会告知你加载了什么
